mapper.select: select ID, EMAIL, PASSWORD, NAME, PROVIDER, PROVIDER_ID, AUTH from USER_INFO where email = #{email} and provider = "LOCAL"
select ID, EMAIL, PASSWORD, NAME, PROVIDER, PROVIDER_ID, AUTH from USER_INFO where provider_id = #{providerId} and provider = #{provider}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO USER_INFO (id, email, password, name, provider, provider_id, auth) VALUES (#{id}, #{email}, #{password}, #{name}, #{provider}, #{providerId}, #{auth})
